{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue (for consistency, even though not used here)
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Check if any QA order is in the 'loyal' segment
qa_in_loyal = qa_orders[qa_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']
print("QA orders in loyal segment:", len(qa_in_loyal))"}
